latest_release.name: v1.7.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(freehire-search): reject detail URLs on other hosts instead of asking the API for their last segment (#622) by @ayobamiseun in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/623
* fix(freehire-search): reject --description-format on detail instead of ignoring it by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/648
* freehire-search: honor Retry-After on 429/503 by @strelov1 in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/632
* freehire-search: us is a country, not a region by @strelov1 in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/630
* fix(freehire-search): say what --region is, and warn when it matches a thin bucket by @GOPNIK64 in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/651
* freehire-search: document the OR and title: operators in -q by @strelov1 in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/674
* fix(job-key): report a non-string url in --audit instead of a traceback by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/634
* fix(rank): report malformed scoring results in apply instead of a traceback by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/635
* fix(rank): report a tracker that is not UTF-8 instead of a traceback by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/639
* fix(rank): keep every --exclude key out of the sweep when the list has spaces by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/641
* fix(salary): collapse line breaks in wrapped workbook headers by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/643
* fix(salary): skip prose notes tabs instead of listing sentences as companies by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/644
* fix(salary): reject non-finite converter baselines by @hopkienne in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/665
* fix(linkedin-search): reject an unknown --remote mode instead of searching every workplace type by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/645
* fix(linkedin-search): require a value for --query instead of dropping the keywords by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/646
* fix(jobindex-search): reject a --sort other than score or date instead of sending it to the portal by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/647
* fix(jobnet-search): filter search by the ESCO occupation that occupations prints by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/649
* fix(jobdanmark-search): filter search by the administrative regions locations returns by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/650
* fix(upstream-triage): skip new upstream files inside a directory the fork removed by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/656
* test(reset): let a personalized profile carry its own ## sections by @ellyess in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/676
* fix(verify-layout): walk PATH candidates for pdftotext supporting -bbox (#655) by @Sonal-sp in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/668
* fix(notion-sync): keep expired-only jobs update-only by @Br-Charb in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/666
* docs(rank): clarify posting search during retrieval by @abdulwasea89 in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/638
* fix(ci): drop persisted checkout credentials and pass matrix.tool through env by @MaverickHQ in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/658
* ci: run the Python suite on Windows by @MadsLorentzen in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/683
* fix(freehire-search): reject an unknown --remote mode by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search/pull/661
* fix(upstream): avoid all-clear after a

detail.readme_excerpt:
An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code.
Fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude evaluate job postings, tailor your CV,
write cover letters, and prepare you for interviews.

Quick start     Commands     How /apply works     Customization     Setup guide

> [!NOTE] > This is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or maintained by Anthropic. Anthropic and Claude Code are referenced only to describe the toolchain this workflow uses. > > This project has **no affiliated cryptocurrency, token, or paid sponsorship program**. Anything claiming otherwise is unauthorized and should be treated as a scam. The only ways to support the project are the Ko-fi link below and contributing on GitHub. ## Does it actually work? I'm a geophysicist by training. When my position was cut in late 2025, I built this framework to run my own job search - the same `/scrape`, `/apply`, and `/interview` workflow in this repo, used weekly, on my own career. I was upfront about it with every employer I spoke to, and instead of counting against me, it usually sparked a genuine technical conversation.

Sixty-nine tailored applications, twenty first interviews, and one signed contract later, I started as an AI engineer in June 2026. Peopl
